note: The line a staff member speaks for each allowed intent of content/ai/intents.json (ADR-0005, ADR-0026). A model only CHOOSES the intent; the words are these. Synthetic, written by the engineer for the simulation: general, free of doses, numbers, diagnoses and orders, and not tied to one case. They are not clinician-reviewed (status awaiting_review). Observations and results that the trainee should hear come from the engine, never from these lines.

nurse.ask_clarification: Sorry, could you say that again so that I get it right?
nurse.confirm_order: Just to check I have this right, you would like me to go ahead with that?
nurse.report_observation: I will check the observations now and tell you what I find.
nurse.ask_prep_status: Has the preparation been completed, the consent, the fasting and the checks?
nurse.report_patient_request: The patient has asked to speak with you about how they are feeling.

anaesthesia.ask_fasting_allergy_airway: Can you tell me about the patient's fasting, allergies and airway?
anaesthesia.raise_approved_concern: I have a concern about this patient. Can we go through it before we carry on?
anaesthesia.respond_to_escalation: I am on my way. Tell me what has changed.
anaesthesia.sign_in_answer: Let us go through the sign in checks together.

surgeon.request_update: Can you give me an update on the patient?
surgeon.decision_response: I have heard your decision. Let me think about it and come back to you.
surgeon.time_out_answer: I am ready for the time out.
surgeon.approved_intraop_issue: There is something I need to tell the team.

porter.confirm_transfer: I can take the patient when you are ready.
porter.report_delay: I am sorry, there will be a short delay.
porter.ask_monitoring: Does the patient need any monitoring on the way?

lab.report_approved_result: I have a result for you. Would you like it now?
lab.report_sample_rejected: I am sorry, the sample could not be used and needs to be taken again.
lab.report_delay: The sample is still being processed.

scrub.report_missing_item: An item seems to be missing from the tray.
scrub.report_fault: One of the items looks faulty.
scrub.count_status: I will go through the count with you.

ward.confirm_admission_details: I am checking the admission details now.
ward.report_bed_status: I will check the bed and let you know.
